title: Session database operations
responsibility: Provide database methods to create, find and revoke authentication sessions.

inputs.name: d1CredentialStores.db
inputs.description: The database handle used to prepare and execute session queries. The constructor returns the store without querying the database.

inputs.name: d1CredentialStores.records
inputs.description: The validator used by sessions.find to convert a matching database row into a session record. It is not called when the query returns no row.

outputs.name: d1CredentialStores
outputs.description: The returned value exposes a sessions store with create, find and revoke methods. create inserts the session fields, find validates a row matching id_hash or returns null, and revoke sets revoked_at for the matching id_hash and its direct children whose revoked_at is null.
